newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 30.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch
this morning:
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.97 (+0.10)
* Foster's Brewing Group Ltd A$2.56 (+0.02)

The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd aimed to sell its 37 percent stake in Foster's Brewing Group Ltd by its May 31 balance date and had said it aimed to sell A$4 billion in assets over the next two years, The Australian Financial Review reported on Thursday, citing market sources.
* Newcrest Mining Ltd A$4.99 (-0.12)

Newcrest Mining Ltd said late on Wednesday it would record a pre-tax unaudited loss before abnormals of A$4.8 million for the December quarter 1996. It said it also expected that the company might only record a breakeven position in the second half to June 1997. Newcrest also warned of a potential write-down of its stake in Normandy Mining Ltd in its half-year financial results, due on February 27.
* Energy Resources of Australia Ltd A$5.60 (unch)

Energy Resources of Australia Ltd said on Wednesday its Ranger mine in the Northern Territory produced 1,100.3 tonnes of uranium oxide in the December quarter, a 168 percent increase on the 410.9 tonnes produced a year earlier.
* News Corp Ltd A$6.68 (unch)

The Fox Channel, a unit of News Corp Ltd, had the highest rating with 14.5 percent of United States households with television sets in the week ending January 26, Nielsen Media Research said on Tuesday. Fox drew the largest average evening-hours audience, earning 23 percent of the television sets in use during those hours. The channel's success appeared to be largely due to its coverage of the Super Bowl football game last Sunday.
* The Seven Network Ltd A$4.12 (+0.04)

Australian television broadcaster Seven Network Ltd said late on Wednesday it remained committed to its investment in the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer (MGM) studios, rejecting recent media speculation that it was unhappy with its holding.
* General Property Trust A$2.41 (+0.01)
GPT announces higher net profit for calendar 1996 of A$167.715 million.
* Corp Express A$0.93 (unch)

Office supplies group Corporate Express Australia Ltd said late on Wednesday slow trading during the holiday season would result in a loss for the half-year ending February 1997 and expects a higher loss in the second half.
* Reef Casino Trust RCT.AX A$0.225 (-0.055)

Shares in Cairns-based gaming house fell on Wednesday after being reinstated on the Australian Stock Exchange. Reef Casino shares were reinstated after releasing a clarifiaction of statements made last week about the search for a new equity investor.
-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
